text: A k=16 Factorization Machine trained with Adam at lr=0.001 on user_id, video_id, author_id, tab, and duration_bucket reproduces the official validation baseline within seed noise (0.6024 versus 0.6016); there is no measurable improvement over the official baseline.

The tested blend of equal-total-weight-per-user and positive-count-proportional user weighting does not improve the k=16 FM; it scored 0.5998, which is 0.0026 below the unweighted reproduction and outside the stated seed-noise threshold.

Adding the tested field-aware FM residual to the validated five-field FM does not measurably improve within-user ranking: validation selected epoch 1 with residual alpha 0.25, but its 0.6018 primary score differs from the 0.6024 FM reproduction by only 0.0006, inside seed noise.
